info.title: Viora Backend API
info.description: Runtime REST surface: Phase 5A authentication and Phase 5B fail-closed business gates.

x-response-headers.ETag: strong opaque validator where the response is a mutable resource

post.description: Public LOGIN transaction. Server generates and encrypts PKCE verifier and nonce. Maximum JSON body 16 KiB. Missing provider or encryption configuration returns 503 AUTH_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.

201.description: Five-minute transaction; verifier is never returned.

post.description: Atomically claims transaction and exchanges code using server-held PKCE. Only verified issuer/subject and an ACTIVE provisioned user may create a session. Any failure after claim requires a new login transaction.

get.description: Authoritative active user/session and membership lookup. Successful zero staff memberships resolves PATIENT without workspace. Multiple memberships require selection; errors and unknown authority fail closed.

Server resolves all active Patient profiles linked to the authenticated user across active clinics. Patient, user and tenant filters are forbidden. Results contain only Patient-safe fields, ordered by startsAt and id.

200.description: Patient-safe appointments and opaque keyset page

post.description: Run 2 self-booking intent contract. Commit remains unavailable until BD-03 policy is approved; valid requests return 503 FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE with decisionId BD-03 and persist no appointment.

200.description: Authorized Patient projection in data envelope; directory also includes page. Detail has a strong ETag matching versionToken.

get.description: BD-01: authenticated active workspace membership, exact permission revision, explicit patient.read grant and role ceiling. CLINIC_ADMIN and NURSE demographic reads use server-side projection and mandatory audit. DOCTOR additionally requires an active persisted same-workspace care relationship for each Patient. Directory pages fail closed if any fetched row lacks authorization. Receptionist workflow necessity remains fail closed. Legacy emergency contact and unclassified fields are omitted.

post.description: Authenticated workspace preflight and exact permission revision are enforced. Returns FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE; awaiting BD-01, BD-02. No domain data is exposed.
